name: DECW World Championship
epitaph: Vacant at the fed's own December 1997 launch, the belt was put up in a 32-man single-elimination tournament that ran across four live rounds that same month; the final, billed for DECW New Year's Bash 98, falls outside this collection's own 1997 holdings and is not held.

name: DECW United States Championship
epitaph: Announced alongside the World Championship as a second belt to be decided by tournament the week after DECW's own December 1997 launch; no result survives in this collection's own 1997 holdings.
notes: DECW Monday Night War Hour #2, 23 December 1997: "tournaments for the World Title and US title."
